maul: next:
  1. Install the App on your account alice:
     https://github.com/apps/maul-acme/installations/new
     Select the intent repository and every application repository.
  2. kubectl create -f maul-github.secret.yaml && rm -f maul-github.secret.yaml && kubectl apply -f maul-github.forge.yaml
     Run it once maul is installed: it needs namespace maul and maul's CRDs.
  3. maul setup project <name> --intent-repo alice/<intent-repo> --repo alice/<app-repo> --approver <github-login> -n maul
maul: the Role binds ServiceAccount maul-intent-controller in maul; pass --intent-controller-sa if your release is not named maul.
maul: for the App just created, change the subject's name in maul-github.forge.yaml instead (kubectl -n maul get serviceaccounts lists it): another run creates another App.
